paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Dangkasik Pengkulte
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Dangka pengkul nih bawl inla; sekthoh in bawl in. Mipi omkhawmte sapkhawmna ding leh pawtsakna dia na zat ding ahi.
english: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.

paite: Huai akimut chiang in mipi omkhawmte tengteng na kiang ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak bul a ahong kikhop vek ding uh ahi.
english: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Khat lel amut uleh Israel mipite heutu intekpente kia na kiang a ahong paikhawm ding uh ahi.
english: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

paite: Gallau mut a na mut uleh suahlam pang a omte apawt ding uhi.
english: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

paite: Gallau mut a na mut nawn uleh simlam pang a omte apawt ding uhi. Apawtna ding un gallau mut bang a amut ding uh ahi.
english: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

paite: Himahleh mipite hong paikhawmna ding in na mut peuhmah ding ua, gallau mut a bel mut lou in.
english: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

paite: Aaron tapa siampute'n pengkul amut ding uh ahi. Huai nou a ding in na suante uh tan a tangtawn dan ahi ding hi.
english: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

paite: Na gam ua melma, nou hon nuaisiahte dou dia na kuan chiang un gallau mut in pengkulte na mut ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian ma uah theihgigena ahi ding ua, na melmate ua pan humbit na hi ding uh.
english: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

paite: Nuam na sak nite un, ahunbi a na ankuangluinate uah, na kha thakte uah, na halmang thillat uahte leh na kilemna thillat kithoihnate uah pengkul na mut ding uh ahi. Huchi in na Pathian ma uah nou a ding in theihgigena ahi ding. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi," chi in.
english: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”

paite: Akum nihna, akha nihna, huai kha ani sawmnih ni in, hichi ahong hi a, meipi in theihsakna biakbuk tung atungkah santa hi.
heading: Israelte'n Giahphual Aphel Uh
english: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante apaidan dungzui in Sinai gamdai a pan apawt ua; Paran gamdai ah meipi akhawlta hi.
english: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

paite: Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang in apawt uhi.
english: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Amasapen in Judah pawlte, apawl uh tamdan dungzui zel in apawt ua; aheutu uh Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

paite: Issakarte heutu Zuar tapa Nethaneel;
english: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

paite: Zebulunte heutu Helon tapa Eliab ahi.
english: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

paite: Biakbuk aphel ua, Gershon tapa leh Merari tapa biakbuk zawng mite apawt uhi.
english: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

paite: Reubente apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Shedeur tapa Elizur ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

paite: Simeonte heutu Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel ahi.
english: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

paite: Gadte heutu Deuel tapa Eliasaph ahi.
english: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

paite: Kohathte'n mun siangthou azawng ua, apawt ua; adangte'n atun ma un biakbuk ana lam uh.
english: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

paite: Ephraimte apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Emihud tapa Elishama ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

paite: Manassehte heutu Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi.
english: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

paite: Benjaminte heutu Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi.
english: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

paite: Ananungpen in Dante apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

paite: Asherte heutu Okran tapa Pagiel ahi.
english: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

paite: Naphtalite heutu Enan tapa Ahira ahi.
english: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

paite: Hiai bang ahi Israel suante pawl atamdan dungzui ua apaidan uh, hiai bang in apai zom zel uhi.
english: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

paite: Mosi sunghpa Midian mi Reuel tapa Hobab kiang ah, Mosi in, "K'on pe ding, TOUPA'N achihna mun ah ka pai ding ua, ka kiang uah hong sam inla, hoihtak in na tung ah ka hih ding uh. TOUPA'N Israel suante tungtang thu lah hoih in agenta ngal a," achi hi.
english: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka hong dah mai ding, ka gam uah ka tanaute kiang ah ka pai zaw mai ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hon paisan mahmah ke'n, gamdai ah lah giahphual satna ding na thei zaw ngal a, kou a ding in mit na hong hi ding hi.
english: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

paite: Hichi ahi dia, ka kiang ua na hong samleh, ahi, hichi ahi ding. TOUPA'N thil hoih hon hihsak bang in ka hon hihsak sam zel ding uhi," achi hi.
english: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA tang a pan ni thum lam ah apai ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm amau a dia kingakna mun zong in ama uah ni thum lam ah ana pai masa hi.
heading: Mipite Apawtkhia Uh
english: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of Yahweh’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

paite: Abuk ua pan apawt un TOUPA meipi sun in atung uah a-om hi.
english: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai bawm apawt ding peuhmah chiang in Mosi in, "TOUPA aw, hong kisa inla, na melmate hawlzak in, nang hon hote na ma ah taikek uhen," achi zel hi.
english: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

paite: Akingakna peuh ah, TOUPA aw, Israel mipi sang tampite kiang ah hong kik nawn in, achi zel hi.
english: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
